text:
Maria Nguyen: Heads up — vendor from ACME Audio is dropping off a fragile crate today around 3pm. They'll need a temporary visitor badge and someone to sign for the package. Can we free a desk by the windows? @frontdesk :package:
FrontDeskBot: Package notice created for ACME Audio. Courier ETA ~15:05. Contact: Maria Nguyen. Assigned locker C4, code `8692`. Please bring ID to claim. :package::label:
Sam Patel: I can put a 'Reserved for guest' sign on hotdesk 4B and move personal stuff into 6C. Maria, are they staying >30 mins? don't want to move twice. :thumbsup:
Maria Nguyen: Yes, should be ~45-60 mins. Also they'll need a parking pass for Visitor Lot B — permit GUEST-B7. Can someone print a temp pass? :parking:
Janie Morales: I can print the parking pass and badge. Will leave both at the front desk in an envelope labeled "ACME / Maria N." Let me know if you want the pass laminated.
Lee Carter: Happy to meet them at the front doors and help with sign-off at 3:10. Which badge type are we doing — temp lanyard or the paper sticker?
Maria Nguyen: Temp lanyard is fine. They have one item marked fragile that needs signature.
FrontDeskBot: Guest ticket #4782 created. Badge type: Temporary lanyard. Parking pass printed and placed with badge (envelope: ACME Audio / Maria Nguyen). Locker C4 will hold the crate until sign-off. Reminder: show ID + sign for fragile item. :white_check_mark:
Sam Patel: Thanks — moving the desk now. Will ping when it's ready.
Janie Morales: Printed the pass and badge. Envelope on front desk. If anyone wants laminated pass, ping me before 14:50.
Lee Carter: Got it. I'll be at the main entrance at 3:05 to escort.
Maria Nguyen: Amazing — thank you all! :wave:
Sam Patel: :thumbsup:
